jobs.name: presentation-maker
jobs.description: Build an offline 16:9 horizontal HTML slide presentation from real source material, with outline, draft, overview grid, speaker notes, and complete-artifact check.

jobs.name: blog-publisher
jobs.description: Publish an independent multi-post journal or publication site with an index, heterogeneous post layouts, offline ZIP bundles, and static deployment.

jobs.name: web-app-builder
jobs.description: Build and deploy a document-driven FastAPI and React web app from a core idea and optional existing product. Use external HTML designs, preserve their appearance, and deploy to the participant's VPS with HTTPS.

jobs.name: bot-builder
jobs.description: Build a deterministic Telegram, Bale or Rubika bot driven by menus, buttons and explicit dialog state, with optional narrow AI helpers. Use for transactional messenger workflows without an autonomous agent loop.

jobs.name: agentic-chatbot
jobs.description: Build an advanced conversational agent with model-selected tools, caller-scoped capabilities, configurable confirmations and enforced usage budgets. Use only when a deterministic bot is inadequate; this workflow requires more review and carries greater operational risk.
